about: The vehicle kit's armoury (docs/vehiclekit/VEHICLEKIT.md, 'The armoury'; Source/VehicleKit/VehicleArmoury.cs). Each recipe is a turret gun in the weapon builder's own text (receiver{socket:part,...}; a splitter's barrels as barrel_N, a muzzle device as {muzzle:...} on its barrel), fitted through the game's build rules, so a player could build every one. merge: 1 a single receiver, 2 or 3 an NxN square of that receiver merged into one N times the size (ReceiverMerge.json: damage N^2 a shot, fire rate / N). box: what feeds it (null: a flame gun, which drinks the vehicle's fuel). class: light, medium or heavy (the roles weigh guns by it). tier: the least threat tier it is common at (below it, a tenth as likely). tags: what it is for (light, medium, heavy, boss, aa, anti-armour, close, suppress, flame, oddity). mount: pintle (open), shield (a gun shield on the arm), twin (two receivers side by side, one gunner). inspired: the Zombies mystery box builds (Parts/Builds) it is taken from. factions: style name -> [weight 1 to 6 (copies in the style's list; each own gun is 1), the faction's name for it]. --check-armoury fits and checks every recipe.

recipes.about: Four rifle receivers bolted into a square: one receiver twice the size on a heavy bore, four rifles' punch a shot at half the rate.
recipes.build: Workhorse Receiver{barrel:Heavy Bore Barrel,feed:Extended Mag,action:Full-Auto Sear}

recipes.about: Four battle rifles merged, semi-automatic on a long barrel: a slow, hard-hitting gun for anything with plates.
recipes.build: Reaper Battle Rifle Receiver{barrel:Long Barrel{muzzle:Muzzle Brake},feed:Extended Mag,action:Semi-Auto Trigger}

recipes.about: Four LMG actions merged into a heavy machine gun on a heatsink barrel: the standard heavy MG.
recipes.build: Bastille LMG Receiver{barrel:Heatsink Barrel,feed:Drum Mag,action:Full-Auto Sear}

recipes.about: Four chain gun receivers merged: a boss gun, twice the size of a heavy MG and as slow as a cannon.
recipes.build: Thumper Chain Gun Receiver{barrel:Big Iron Barrel,feed:Belt Box,action:Chain Drive Motor}

recipes.about: Nine rifle receivers in a 3x3: a gun three times the size, nine rifles a shot at a third the rate. Only the biggest trucks carry one.
A chain gun through a cross splitter: four heavy barrels up, down, left and right.
recipes.build: Thumper Chain Gun Receiver{barrel:Cross Splitter{barrel_1:Standard Barrel,barrel_2:Standard Barrel,barrel_3:Standard Barrel,barrel_4:Standard Barrel},feed:Belt Box,action:Chain Drive Motor}

recipes.about: An LMG through a totem splitter: four stub barrels stacked up, a wall of rounds for anything that flies.
recipes.build: Bastille LMG Receiver{barrel:Totem Splitter{barrel_1:Stub Barrel,barrel_2:Stub Barrel,barrel_3:Stub Barrel,barrel_4:Stub Barrel},feed:Drum Mag,action:Full-Auto Sear}

recipes.about: An autocannon through a ladder splitter: six heavy stub barrels in two rows.
recipes.build: Hammerfall Autocannon Receiver{barrel:Ladder Splitter{barrel_1:Stub Barrel,barrel_2:Stub Barrel,barrel_3:Stub Barrel,barrel_4:Stub Barrel,barrel_5:Stub Barrel,barrel_6:Stub Barrel},feed:Heavy Box,action:Autocannon Drive}

recipes.about: A battle rifle with its barrels over and under.
recipes.build: Reaper Battle Rifle Receiver{barrel:Over-Under Splitter{barrel_1:Standard Barrel,barrel_2:Standard Barrel},feed:Extended Mag,action:Marksman Trigger}

recipes.about: A full-auto shotgun on a drum behind a gun shield: rooms, and decks, empty quickly.
recipes.build: Gravedigger Auto Receiver{barrel:Scattermouth Barrel{muzzle:Tumbler Ring},feed:Shell Drum,action:Heavy Auto Sear}

recipes.about: Two belt-fed chain guns side by side on one cradle, one gunner: the convoy's fire support.

recipes.about: Two LMG actions side by side: a twin mount any crew can rig.

recipes.about: The autocannon receiver on a stub barrel: even the stub comes out the size of a drainpipe.
